testcase.name: Transfer migration creates complete typed schema, indexes and enforced constraints
Transfer migration rerun preserves header, lines and schema
Transfer header rejects same warehouse, invalid state/version, missing/duplicate operations
Transfer lines enforce parent, bins and composite SKU/Lot ownership
Transfer line quantity, whole in-transit amount, statuses and line uniqueness are constrained
Transfer movement references are optional, restrictive and retry-safe after interrupted FK attachment
Transfer migration fails closed on incompatible existing index, check and FK without further DDL
